# Juan Cruz-Benito

> Quantum+AI Manager at IBM Research. PhD in Computer Engineering (University of Salamanca, 2018). Works at the intersection of quantum computing, machine learning, and open source.

Juan Cruz-Benito researches and develops AI-based systems for quantum computing and other complex problems. His work spans quantum computing, machine learning, and open source software. He holds IBM Master Inventor status, has authored 80+ publications, and received the 2019 SCIE-BBVA Award for best young researcher in Computer Science in Spain.

## Key pages

- [About](https://cbjuan.github.io/): Bio, education, interests, and contact details.
- [Publications](https://cbjuan.github.io/publication/): 80+ peer-reviewed papers and articles on AI, quantum computing, and open source, going back to 2013.
- [Projects](https://cbjuan.github.io/project/): Open-source projects, including AI tooling for Qiskit.
- [Talks](https://cbjuan.github.io/talk/): Conference talks and invited lectures.

## Featured projects

- [Qiskit Code Assistant](https://cbjuan.github.io/project/qiskit-code-assistant/): Family of open-source LLMs (8B-24B) for quantum code generation, plus the Qiskit HumanEval benchmarks.
- [Qiskit MCP Servers](https://cbjuan.github.io/project/qiskit-mcp-servers/): Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers connecting AI assistants and agents to IBM Quantum services.
- [qiskit-ibm-transpiler](https://cbjuan.github.io/project/qiskit-ibm-transpiler/): AI-powered quantum circuit optimization library, ranked 3rd in the Unitary Foundation 2025 Survey with 929K+ downloads.
- [Qiskit Gym](https://cbjuan.github.io/project/qiskit-gym/): Reinforcement learning environments for quantum circuit synthesis.
